eligibility_evidence: Role Description The Low Current Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining low current systems such as security, CCTV, access control, structured cabling, fire alarm, and related IT/communication infrastructure.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: With more than 20 years of combined experience in IT, low current, and security systems, INT is committed to advancing the growth of its customers, team members, and communities. Day-to-day activities include reviewing project requirements, conducting site surveys, preparing low current system designs and shop drawings, and selecting appropriate equipment and materials in line with project specifications and standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong low current and security systems skills, including design, implementation, testing, and maintenance of CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, fire alarm, and related systems.
